title: Playing excursions out of New Orleans
summary: Miller played the booster excursions on the Southern Pacific, the best being Chicago to Memphis.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Did you play any excursions out of here?
I'm the only one who played them. Till I left in Lee College and played one. But I played all the booster excursions. Every time one went out, I was the guy that played it.
Where'd you go on those things?
Homer. On the Southern Pacific, you better say that. But the best excursions I ever played was from Chicago to Memphis.
